verdict.rationale: Pulley's fundraising-modeling product page says founders can get a pro-forma for a next priced round or SAFE and run pre- and post-financing scenarios. That covers the core of modeling a priced round and its pro-forma ownership, but the evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: explicit option pool top-up modeling, documented SAFE-to-preferred conversion mechanics, evidence of sharing scenarios with counsel or investors, in-depth help-center docs for the modeling tool, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
